name: Samuel L. Devine
summary: Samuel Leeper Devine (December 21, 1915 – June 27, 1997) was an American politician an member of the Republican Party who served in the United States House of Representatives as Representative of the 12th congressional district of Ohio from January 3, 1959, until January 3, 1981; he left office after being defeated by Bob Shamansky, a Democrat, who then lost the seat after a single term to Republican John Kasich. During the 96th Congress, Devine was the Chairman of the House Republican Conference.
